title: ScMetaEntry
description:
ScMetaEntry is an XDR Union defined as:

```text union SCMetaEntry switch (SCMetaKind kind) { case SC_META_V0: SCMetaV0 v0; }; ```

ScMetaV0.description:
ScMetaV0 is an XDR Struct defined as:

```text struct SCMetaV0 { string key<>; string val<>; }; ```

key.description: Byte string, not UTF-8, of at most 4294967295 bytes, escaped per SEP-51: printable ASCII (0x20-0x7e) is unchanged, except backslash as \\; NUL, tab, LF and CR as \0, \t, \n and \r; any other byte as \xNN. The escaped string may be longer than 4294967295 characters.

val.description: Byte string, not UTF-8, of at most 4294967295 bytes, escaped per SEP-51: printable ASCII (0x20-0x7e) is unchanged, except backslash as \\; NUL, tab, LF and CR as \0, \t, \n and \r; any other byte as \xNN. The escaped string may be longer than 4294967295 characters.
